task: ae.cal: calendar conversions over epoch days (Gregorian, Julian, hybrid cutover, Islamic civil), month arithmetic, ISO week and ordinal dates, Easter, differentially tested against the JDK
reasoning_summary: Epoch days are the single pivot; every system converts via Julian Day Number with floor-division integer algorithms. Gregorian is swept over 4M days against LocalDate, Julian/hybrid over years 1..3000 against GregorianCalendar, ISO weeks and month arithmetic against java.time. A 22-mutant pass found gaps (no Islamic sweep, no month-start contiguity test, no 1700s Easter) that were closed with a day-by-day walk test and an independent Gauss Easter oracle.
